verdict.rationale: Choosing a storage region is a fair question for a SaaS accounting product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, region selection, or where data is hosted. The items cover invoicing, bookkeeping, banking, ELSTER filing and the REST API, none of which bear on storage location.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
